tapResume: Paused in the background. Tap to resume.

defaults.hint: Each player can still turn any of these off for themselves in Profile → Voice.

saveFailed: Could not save the voice settings

source.label: Read messages aloud with
source.hint: Phone voices are your phone’s or browser’s own; nothing leaves your device. Turn on Listen (the ear) in a room.
source.hint2: Server voices (recommended): made on this site’s server, so they sound the same on every device: male, female and neutral voices in US or UK English and in Greek; each character speaks with the voice of its gender, and the Storyteller with the chronicle’s narrator. My device’s voices: the voices built into your phone or computer; nothing leaves your device, but what you get depends on it: some have no Greek voice, and some computers have no voices at all (for example Linux without a speech engine). When the device has no voice, the server voices read the line instead. Turn on Listen (the ear) in a room.

fallback: Server voices are busy or off; using your phone’s voice for now.
previewFailed: Could not play the sample. Try again in a moment.

narrator.hint: Used for the Storyteller, actions and dice results for players who listen with server voices.
narrator.off: Server voices are not running on this site, so the narrator voice cannot be chosen now. The default is used.

gender.label: Voice
gender.hint: Which voice reads this character’s lines aloud. Not set uses a neutral voice.
gender.reminder: Set a voice so this character is read aloud with a matching voice. Until then a neutral voice is used.

rec.title: Voice message
rec.empty: No words were heard. Type what you said, or record again.
rec.busy: The server’s speech engine is busy. Type what you said, or use phone dictation.
rec.tooLong: The recording is too long for the server.
rec.diskFull: The server has no room for more recordings. Tell the site admin.
rec.down: The speech service is not running. Type what you said, or use phone dictation.
rec.failed: Transcription failed. Type what you said, or record again.
rec.dictationFailed: Phone dictation stopped. Type what you said.
rec.noDictation: This phone has no dictation here. Type what you said.
rec.dictating: Listening… tap Stop when you are done.
rec.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your phone’s Settings, then try again.
rec.deniedShort: Microphone blocked: allow the microphone in Settings
rec.translateFailed: Could not translate it now. Send it as you said it, or try again.
rec.originalKept: Your words in {{lang}} stay under the message as “your original”.

stt.label: Voice messages are written by
stt.hint: The server keeps your recording so the table can replay it. Phone dictation sends your audio to Apple or Google and keeps no recording.

rules.phone: Players may use their phone’s dictation (audio goes to Apple or Google)

hear.label: Read and hear messages in
hear.hint: Lines in the other language are translated on the server ahead of time and shown in your language, with the original a tap away.

write.label: Voice messages are sent in
write.hint: Speak in one language and send the other: you see both before you send, and your original words stay under the message.
